nodes.label: Native app icon PNG renderer
nodes.rationale: Uses CoreGraphics and ImageIO to render a 1024-pixel teal rounded tile, white trackpad and sparkle to the supplied PNG output path.

nodes.label: Build and run live-session sampler
nodes.rationale: Compiles tests/resource-sample.c and runs its binary against the supplied app PID, writing live-performance.json.

nodes.label: Live RAM and CPU session sampler
nodes.norm_label: live ram and cpu session sampler
nodes.rationale: Records every half-second; finishes after all three modes and ten idle seconds or after ten minutes. Cleaning values map idle=0, trackpad=1, keyboard=2, both=3. The documented ten-minute live observation remained idle throughout and does not establish RAM or CPU usage while cleaning.

nodes.label: Event-tap cleaning mode detection
nodes.rationale: Pointer and system-defined event-mask bits identify idle=0, trackpad=1, keyboard=2, both=3.

nodes.label: Logic check entry
nodes.rationale: Checks Escape sequence semantics, mode-specific filters, event masks and byte-for-byte native mouse event preservation.

nodes.label: Opt-in aggregate input diagnostics
nodes.rationale: TRACKPADCLEAN_DIAGNOSTICS records device sender IDs and blocked/passed counts without keystrokes or coordinates.

nodes.label: Five distinct Escape presses
nodes.rationale: Consecutive presses must be within 1.5 seconds; holding Escape does not count and another key resets the sequence. A five-minute timeout also restores input.

nodes.label: Temporary cleaning event filter
nodes.rationale: Runs only during cleaning; confines trackpad movement to the last allowed cursor position and suppresses its events. Identified mouse events return unchanged. Temporary tap interruptions resume when macOS permits.

nodes.label: Native external mouse preservation
nodes.rationale: External mouse events pass through unchanged, preserving macOS sensitivity and acceleration.

nodes.label: Keyboard and media-key filtering limits
nodes.rationale: Ordinary keys, modifiers and media controls are blocked from all keyboards. Power, Touch ID and macOS-reserved controls remain outside the app control.

nodes.label: Logic and UI checks
nodes.rationale: Automated callback checks pass for keyboard and combined cleaning modes; their physical confirmation remains pending. Trackpad blocking, native mouse sensitivity, and recovery were physically checked during development.

nodes.label: Optional native login startup
nodes.rationale: The executable supports enable-login, disable-login and login-status. Build does not enable startup; native registration requires macOS 13 or later.

nodes.norm_label: cgevent sender field 87 and ioregistry routing
nodes.rationale: Unknown pointing-device sources are suppressed, which may block drivers or generated pointer events that hide their hardware source. Escape remains available for recovery.

nodes.label: Glass card, IOSurface and deferred-window cleanup
nodes.norm_label: glass card, iosurface and deferred-window cleanup
nodes.rationale: Clear Liquid Glass on macOS 26+ has a translucent popover fallback. One IOSurface draws system typography. Temporary surfaces and window are released on dismissal, and a local event wakes AppKit to drain deferred resources. A space-efficient allocator reduces retained heap memory; no repeating cursor polling timer exists.
